visa_requirement_type: Visitor visa (subclass 600) - Tourist stream (apply outside Australia)
maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 12 months may be granted; the actual stay period and entries are specified in the visa grant.
passport_validity_rule: Passport must meet the destination authority's validity requirement for the full intended trip; check the current official checklist.
blank_passport_pages_rule: Follow the responsible authority's current passport-page requirements.
return_ticket_rule: Return or onward travel evidence may be requested; provide a credible itinerary.
proof_of_funds_rule: Provide evidence of sufficient funds for the full trip; exact requirements depend on the destination and case.
accommodation_rule: Provide hotel booking or host/accommodation details as required by the destination authority.
travel_insurance_rule: Check whether travel medical insurance is mandatory for the visa category; it is recommended where not mandatory.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: Health and vaccination requirements depend on recent travel/residence and current public-health rules.
transit_rule: A separate airport transit visa may be required depending on routing, airport, terminal change and onward destination; verify before ticketing.
application_channel: Apply online through ImmiAccount under Visitor visa (subclass 600), Tourist stream (apply outside Australia). Applicants must be outside Australia when applying and when the decision is made.
application_fee: AUD 250 per applicant (subclass 600 Tourist stream, offshore); other provider charges separate.
processing_time: Live Home Affairs subclass 600 guide; recent decisions only, not a guarantee.
required_documents: Valid passport|Online ImmiAccount application|Recent photograph if requested|Evidence of funds|Travel itinerary|Accommodation details|Evidence of employment/business and ties to home country|Invitation/sponsor documents if applicable|Health/character documents if requested
official_immigration_source_name: Migration Regulations 1994, Compilation 289 (2 October 2026), Schedule 1 item 1236

maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period across the entire Schengen area

transit_rule: Airport transit visa requirements depend on airport, routing, destination and individual circumstances; check before travel.

application_fee: EUR 90 adult; EUR 45 ages 6–11; under 6 exempt; external-provider fee extra.
processing_time: 15 calendar days from admissible filing; may extend to 45 days in individual cases.
